data.titulo: Kebebertab 4—Laitoriatab Israel ne Tai Agoi Kimuti Israelik Koba Babulon
data.contenido:
Ki ek Saul laitoriat ne tai ne bo Israel. Nga u noto, ko kieesio Jehovah inendet ak kolewen Daudi koek laitoriat. Kinetigei tuguk che chang’ agobo Daudi. Kingo neran anan barnotiot, ko kibar Goliat. Ki tun komwee Laitoriat Saul ne ki kipng’etkong’ia. Kinetigei kora agobo kwondo ne ki kararan ne kiguure Abigail ne ki tun ko ter Daudi si ma yai kit ne ya.

Ne rubei, kinetigei tuguk che chang’ agobo weritab Daudi Solomon, ne kiek laitoriatab Israel kingobata laitornatetab Daudi. Eng’ laitorinik somok che tai eng’ Israel, ko ki laitoran age tugul kenyisiek 40. Kingo kagome Solomon, kepchei Israel koek bounatosiek aeng’, bounatetab murot katam ak ne bo murot tai.

Ki bororiosiek 10 bounatetab murot katam, ago ki tun kobwa bikab Asuria kong’em bounatonito kingobata kenyisiek 257. Kisiirto kasarta ne bo kenyisiek 133, keng’em kora bounatetab murot tai ne ki bororiosiek aeng’. Kingeng’em bounatonito, kenam Israelik ak kimut koba Babulon. Ko u noto, kong’alalee Kebebertab ANG’WAN tuguk che bo kwong’ut che ki yaagis eng’ kenyisiek 510.

data.titulo: Saul—Laitoriat ne Tai ne bo Israel
data.contenido:
TOS igeere Samuel koroong’kyin mwaita metitab chichi mi pichaini? Ki cham keyae ko u nito si koboor kole kagilewen chito koek laitoriat. Kilenji Jehovah Samuel koroong’kyi mwaita metitab Saul. Ki mwaiyata ko ki teer eng’ mwanik alak ago ki ng’uu ne anyiny.

Ki ma kobwati Saul kole imuchi koek laitoriat. Kolenji Samwel: ‘Abunu bororietab Benjamin, bororiet ne ming’in eng’ Israel tugul. Amu nee si ilenjo aegu laitoriat?’ Ki cham Jehovah Saul amu ma keergei ko u yo chi ne o ak ko bo kamanut. Noto amu nee si ki lewen koek laitoriat.

Nga u noto, ko melen ki chi ne ki ma kotinyei tugun Saul. Ki magorek bikwak ago ki kararan ne bo kwong’ut itondonyi. Ki chi ne koi kosiir chi tugul eng’ Israel, ki ng’weng’ anan ki chepchep eng’ labatet ago ki kim ne bo kwong’ut. Ki boiboitu bik ne bo kwong’ut amu ki lewen Jehovah Saul koek laitoriat. Kimwa bik tugul eng’ kutit ne o kole: ‘Ngomeng’is laitoriat koek keny!’

Ta ko kimen bunikab Israel ko u keny ak konyalili Israelik. Kingoek Saul laitoriat kityo, kobwa Amonik kobargei ak Israelik. Kiiyum anyun Saul bikab luget che chang’, ago ki sindan Amonik. Ki boiboitu bik amu ki laitoriandennywa Saul.

Ki ye tesetai kobendi kenyisiek, kotestai kondochi Saul Israelik kosindan bunikwak. Ki tinyei kora Saul werit ne nyigan ne ki kiguure Jonatan ne ki toret Israelik kosindonis eng’ lugosiek che chang’. Ta ko bunik che eechen Pilistik che bo Israelik. Kibwa betut agenge Pilistik che chang’ ne bo kwong’ut kobargei ak Israelik.

Ko u noto, kolenji Samuel Saul kogany agoi koit inendet si kogochi Jehovah tiseiywot. Nga u noto, ko kiigagei Samuel. Koywei anyun Saul kole imuch konaam Pilistik boriet kotomo koit Samuel, amu noto kogoito tiseiywot inendet kit ne ki ma ko nyolu koyai. Ki ye it Samuel, kolenji Saul: ‘Leweni Jehovah chito age koek laitoriatab Israel,’ amu ma kas it Jehovah.

Kingelelji Saul Jehovah kogeny. Kolenji Samuel Saul: ‘Kaigai kegas it Jehovah kosiir kigochi konunotiotab kechiriet ne kararan. Amu ma igas it Jehovah, ko ma koyanun Jehovah itestai iegu laitoriatab Israel.’

Inetech nito kole bo kamanut kegas it Jehovah betusiek tugul. Ineetech kora kole, imuchi kowalak chito ne ki kararan ko u Saul koek chi ne ya. Ma kimache keegu bik che yaachen, tos ma iman?1 Samuel kurgetab 9 agoi 11; 13:5-14; 14:47-52; 15:1-35; 2 Samuel 1:23. Teebutik che Kineetengei

TOS igeere kit ne kayaak eng’ pichaini? Kagosor chichi aruetab kechir ne kaagonam tiondab timin. Kanyo tionyi ak konam aruani ko machei koam. Koon chichi ak kosor aruani eng’ kutitab tionyi ak kokwer kome! Mi kasarta kora ne ki sor chichito kechiriet ne kiga konam ng’etundo. Tos ma nyigan chichi ne bo kwong’ut? Tos ingen kainennyi?

Kiguure Daudi ago eng’ yu ko ki ta ko mining’. Menyei nganasetab Bet-lehem. Inendet ko mochogoretab Obed ne ki weritab Ruth ak Boas. Tos ta ibwati Ruth ak Boas? Kwandab Daudi keguure Jesii ago iyogi Daudi kechirekab kwandanyi. Kigisichei Daudi kogakobata kenyisiek 10 kong’eete ngolewen Jehovah Saul koek laitoriat.

Kiit kasarta ne kilenji Jehovah Samuel: ‘Amache inam mwaita ak iwe agoi kap Jesii eng’ Bet-lehem amu ko alewen agenge eng’ werikyik koek laitoriat.’ Kingogeer Samuel werit ne o ne bo Jesii ne kiguure Eliab, kolenjigei: ‘Oiye nito ne kogolewen Jehovah.’ Nga u noto, kolenji Jehovah Samuel: ‘Mat igeer koindonyi anan ko karoronindonyi, ma alewen inendet koek laitoriat.’

Koguur anyun Jesii werinnyi ne kiguure Abinadab. Kole Samuel: ‘Ma ni kora ne kalewen Jehovah.’ Kiguur kogeny Jesii werit ne kiguure Sama, kolenji Samuel: ‘Achicha, ma lewen Jehovah nito agine.’ Kiguurji Jesii Samuel werik tisab ago ma lewen Jehovah agot agenge eng’ choto. Koteebe Samuel Jesii kole: ‘Weriguk tugul chuto?’

Kolenji Jesii Samuel: ‘Ta komi werit ne ming’in ne kawo korib kechirek.’ Kingoit Daudi, kogeer Samuel kole ki werit ne ki tinyei iton ne kararan. Kolenji Jehovah Samuel: ‘Nito ne kaalewen, iil inendet.’ Ki yai Samuel ko u noto. Ko u noto, ko itei kasarta ne nyo koegu Daudi laitoriatab Israel.1 Samuel 17:34, 35; 16:1-13. Teebutik che Kineetengei

KIIT kasarta age ne kibwa Pilistik kobargei ak Israelik kogeny, ago eng’ bikab Saul che bo boriet ko ki mi tupchosiekab Daudi somogu. Ko u noto, ko mi betut ne kilenji Jesii Daudi: ‘Ipchii amitwogik tupchosieguk ak igeer ole u.’

Kingoit Daudi ole ki biren kambi bikab boriet, kwo kocheng’ tupchosiekyik. Konyo Pilistindet ne o borto ne bo kwong’ut ne keguure Goliat ak kororechi Israelik. Ki cham kororechin Israelik kila subui ak kosgoleny eng’ kasartab betusiek 40. Kimwa Goliat eng’ kutit ne o kole: ‘Olewen agenge eng’ murenikwok konyo kebargei tuwai. Ngot kobaran, keegu otwogikwok. Ko ngot abar, oegu otwogikyok. Ago ngot ko onyigonen, olewen chi kebargei tuwai.’ Koteebe Daudi bikab boriet kole: ‘Kigochin nee chito ne barei Pilistindoni ak kotiach Israelik si ma ta kerorechi?’

Kewolji Daudi kelenji: ‘Igochin Saul chichoto mogornatet ak kogochi cheptanyi koek kwondanyi.’

Nga u noto, ko kiiywei Israelik Goliat ne bo kwong’ut amu ki chi ne ki o borto. Oindo ak koindonyi ko ki nyilen aeng’ ne bo chi, ago ki mi chito age ne kitoreti Goliat koipchin long’et.

Ki ba anyun alak eng’ bikab boriet komwochi Saul kole machei Daudi kobargei ak Goliat. Kolenji Saul Daudi: ‘Ma imuchi ibar Pilistindoni. Inye ko ta imining’, ko inendet ko chi ne ki kwo boriet eng sobennyi tugul.’ Kole Daudi: ‘Ki abar tiondab timin ak ng’etundo ne kiga konam kechirietab kwandanyu. Kergei Pilistindoni ak tiong’ichoto. Toreton Jehovah.’ Kolenji Saul Daudi: ‘Ui, ago ngotoretin Jehovah.’

Kwo Daudi agoi ainet, kokwei koik mut ak konde lolennyi anan mapugennyi. Konam chemasindoriet anan mandilit ak kwo kotorokta Goliat. Kingogeer Goliat Daudi kogeer kole mining’ ago ki ibwati kole imuchi kobar Daudi eng’ nyumnyumindo.

Kilenji Goliat Daudi: ‘Nyo si igeer, agochini bortang’ung’ taritik ak tiong’ik koam.’ Kole Daudi: ‘Inyonjo ak rotwetab chok ak ng’otit, ago anyonjin anendet eng’ kainetab Jehovah. Amwaun ale, toreton Jehovah rani abarin.’

Ki labat Daudi anyun sainoto kotokyigei ole mi Goliat. Konem koita ak konde chemasindariet anan mandilit ak kowir Goliat eng’ kimnatennyi tugul. Ki wo koita ak kokwer metitab Goliat! Kobut Goliat ak kome. Ki ye keer Pilistik kole kagobut Goliat, korwai. Kioon anyun Israelik ak kosindonis eng’ boriet.1 Samuel 17:1-54. Teebutik che Kineetengei

data.titulo: Amu Nee si ko Magat Komwei Daudi
data.contenido:
KINGO kagobar Daudi Goliat, komut Abner Daudi kwo ole mi Saul. Abner ko ki ne o ne bo bikab boriet. Ki boibochi Saul Daudi ne bo kwong’ut. Kiinde koek ne o ne bo bikyik che bo boriet ak komut kwo komeny gotab laitoriat.

Ki ye week bik eng’ boriet, kotienso kwonyik kole: ‘Kigobar Saul elfusiek, ko Daudi ko kigobar tamanusiekab elfusiek.’ Ki am ng’etkong’ Saul kingo kas kiloosu Daudi kosiir inendet. Nga u noto, ko maam ng’etkong’ Jonatan, weritab Saul. Chamei Jonatan Daudi ne bo kwong’ut ago chamei Daudi Jonatan agine. Ko u noto, komwachigei kole tesetai koegu choronok agoi let. Ingen Daudi kobut kibugandit ne bo kwong’ut ago boibochin Saul tienwogik che butei Daudi. Nga u noto, ko mi betut ne ki yai Saul kit ne ya mising’ amu ng’etkonda ne ki tinyei. Kingo ta kobutei Daudi kibugandit, konam Saul ng’otit ak kotoorta komachei kotoor Daudi. Kile: ‘Atiing’jini Daudi inat!’ Nga u noto, ko kieban Daudi. Ki tiem kora Saul kotoore ng’otit Daudi ago ma nam. Kong’eete yoto, konai anyun Daudi kole magat koribgei.

Tos ta ibwati kit ne ki kamwa Saul kole yaei? Ki kale igochin chito ne barei Goliat cheptanyi koek kwondanyi. Komwachi Saul anyun Daudi kole, magat kobar Pilistik 100 korok si kogochi cheptanyi Mikal. Kiibwati Saul kole imuch kobar Pilistik Daudi. Nga u noto, ko ma bar Pilistik Daudi, kiyaach anyun kogochi Saul Daudi cheptanyi koek kwondanyi.

Ki mwachi Saul Jonatan ak kiboitinikyik tugul besio kole machei kobar Daudi. Kolenji Jonatan Saul: ‘Mat iite kiy Daudi. Tomo koyaun kiy ne ya ole kigoi, kiy age tugul ne kigoyai ko kigotoretin. Ki bar Daudi Goliat, kit ne ki ma konyumnyum koyai amu kiimuch kebar, ago kiibaibain noto.’

Ki kas Saul kit ne kimwachi werinnyi ak kole ma yachin kiy ne ya Daudi. Ki week Daudi konyo kotestai koboisiechi Saul kogeny eng’ gonnyi ko u keny. Nga u noto, ko mi betut ne kingo ta kobutei tiendo Daudi, kotoorta Saul kogeny ng’otinnyi komachei kotoor Daudi. Ki ne bo somok nito ago kinai anyun Daudi kole nyolu komwei!

Ki wo Daudi gonnyi betunoto. Nga u noto, koyookto Saul bik koba kobar Daudi. Ki nai Mikal agobo kit ne kiga kopangan kwandanyi, kolenji manong’otiondennyi: ‘Ngot ko memwei rani kemboi, ko ngoitei karon ko kaimeei.’ Ki toret anyun Mikal Daudi komwei kobun tirisia kemounoto. Ki yaach kounygei Daudi kenyisiek tisab eng’ komoswek che teerchin si ma nyor Saul.1 Samuel 18:1-30; 19:1-18. Teebutik che Kineetengei

TOS ingen ile ng’o kwonyi kararan nyonei kotuiytos ak Daudi? Kiguure Abigail. Ng’om kwonyito ago inendet ne ki ter Daudi si ma yai kit ne ya. Kotomo kinetgei agobo noto, ko ngegeer kit ne yaaksei eng’ Daudi.

Kingo kagomwee Daudi Saul, kwo kounygei eng’ kebenet. Ki ba tupchosiekyik ak bikab gonnyi kotebi tugul eng’ oloto. Bik tugul che ki ba ko ki 400, ago kiek Daudi kandoindennywa. Ki wo anyun Daudi kotuiyo ak laitoriatab Moab ak kolenji: ‘Kaigai chamji babanyun ak kamennyu otebi tugul kot anai kit ne yaaksei eng’ ane.’ Ki ye ibata, konaam kounygei Daudi ak bikyik eng’ tulonok.

Ki kasarito ye ki tuiyo Daudi ak Abigail. Manong’otiotab Abigail ne kiguure Nabal, ko magoriot ne ki tinyei mbaret ne o, ki tinyei kechirek 3,000 ak nego anan ng’ororek 1,000. Nabal ko ki chi ne ng’ok anan suiyon, ko Abigail ko kiingen koyai tuguk che miach ago ki tinyei iton ne kararan. Mi betut agenge ne ki sor Abigail bikab gonnyi. Ngegeer kit ne kiyaak.

Ki bik che miach Daudi ak bikyik amu ki toret Nabal koribchi kechirek. Kiit betut anyun ne kiiyookto Daudi bikyik kosom Nabal amitwogik. Kingo itei bikab Daudi, ko ki mi Nabal ak kiboitinikyik kotiljin kechirek manyoek anan kororik. Ki tinyei Nabal igoorto betunoto ago ki chang’ amitwogik. Kolenji bikab Daudi Nabal: ‘Kigeyaun ne mie, ma kichor kechireguk, ne kata u noto ko kigiribun. Kaigai toretech kiy ne kiamei.’

Kole Nabal: ‘Magochini amitwogikyuk bik che u okwek.’ Ki ng’alal Nabal eng’ oret ne ya ne bo kwong’ut, ago kimwa tuguk che yaach agobo Daudi. Kingowektagei bichoto ak komwachi Daudi kit ne kamwa Nabal, konerech Daudi mising’ ak kole: ‘Ingonam chi tugul rotwetab chok!’ Ki nam banda tugul anyun koba kobar Nabal ak bikyik.

Ki wo agenge eng’ kiboitinikab Nabal ne ki kasei kong’alali Nabal ak komwachi Abigail kit ne kayaak. Kochob Abigail amitwogik sainoto ak koratyi sigirok amitwogichoto ak konaam banda. Kingo tuiyo ak Daudi, kochoorgei eng’ sigiriet ak kogutuny ak kole: ‘Kaigai mat iepchi it manong’otiondennyu, Nabal. Berber inendet ago yae tuguk che berber. Atinye kononutiot eng’ yu, kaigai taach ak inyoiywech kat eng’ kit ne kayaak.’

Kowol Daudi kole: ‘I kwondo ne ng’om, kaiteero si ma bar Nabal kosuubgei ak yaitiennyi. Ui gaa anyun eng’ kalyet.’ Kingo me Nabal, komut Daudi Abigail koek agenge eng’ kwonyikyik.1 Samuel 22:1-4; 25:1-43. Teebutik che Kineetengei

KI TIEM kogeny Saul konam Daudi. Ki lewen askarikyik 3,000 che kimen ak koba kocheng’ Daudi. Kingo nai nito Daudi, koyookto segeik koba kocheng’ ole mi Saul ak bikyik kemounoto. Koteebe Daudi bikyik aeng’ kole: ‘Ng’o eng’ okwek ne kebendi tuwai kambitab Saul?’

Kowol Abisai kole: ‘Kibendi tuwai.’ Abisai ko weritab Seruia, chepto ne tupcho ak Daudi. Kingo ta koruiytos Saul ak bikyik, kowaiytagei anan koteelda Daudi ak Abisai agoi kambit orit. Konem ng’otit ak chagitab beek ne bo Saul che ki mi ole negite metitab Saul. Ma mi chi ne kigeer anan kogas amu ki ruiytos tugul rwondo ne nyigis.

Igeere Daudi ak Abisai eng’ pichait? Kagomanda eng’ kambitab Saul ak koba agoi tulwet barak. Kingoit tulwet barak, koguur anyun Daudi Abner, ne o ne bo bikab boriet che bo Israel kole: ‘Abner, amu nee si meriibe kiptaiyandeng’ung’, laitoriat? Keero! Mi ano ng’otinnyi ak chaginnyi ne bo beek?’

Ki ng’eet Saul eng’ rwondo ago ki nai kutitab Daudi, koteeb kole: ‘Daudi, inye no?’ Tos igeere Saul ak Abner eng’ pichait ne mi pechinon age?

Kowol Daudi kole: ‘Ee, ane kiptaiyandennyu, amu nee si imache inama? Kiayai nee ne ya? Atinye ng’oting’ung’, Ee laitoriat. Iyoogu agenge eng’ biguk konyo koibun.’ Komwa Saul kole: ‘Kialeel, ago koaberberitu.’ Kingo kagomwa Saul ko u noto, kwechigei Daudi ak koweektagei agine Saul gaa. Kolenjigei anyun Daudi: ‘Boron Saul betut agenge. Nyolu amwei awo emetab Pilistik.’ Ago noto kit ne ki yai Daudi. Kingoit emetab Pilistik, kong’al Pilistik koyan kole mi tugul kibagenge.

Kingo kagosiirto kasarta, koba Pilistik kobargei ak Israel. Ki kibar Saul ak Jonatan eng’ borionoto. Ki yai nito koiimgei Daudi mising’ ak kosir tiendo ne mwae kole: ‘Aiimigei agobo inye tupchennyu Jonatan. Ki i choruennyu ne tia!’

Ki week anyun Daudi ak kwo agoi nganasetab Hebron eng’ emetab Israel. Ki tesetai boriet eng’ bik che kiga lewen Is-boset weritab Saul koek laitoriat ak bik che ki machei koek Daudi laitoriat. Nga u noto, ko ki eng’ let kosindonis bikab Daudi. Ki bo kenyisiek 30 Daudi kingoegu laitoriat. Ki laitoran kenyisiek tisab ak nusu eng’ Hebron. Kisich werik Daudi eng’ Hebron ago alak eng’ werichoto keguure Amnon, Absalom ak Adonija.

Kiit kasarta ne ki ba Daudi ak bikyik koba kotegan nganaset ne kararan ne kiguure Jerusalem. Kiindochin lugonoto Joab, werit age ne bo chepto ne tupcho ak Daudi ne kiguure Seruia. Amu noto, koyai Daudi anyun Joab koek ne o ne bo bikyik che bo boriet. Kiinaam anyun Daudi kolaitoran nganasetab Jerusalem.1 Samuel 26:1-25; 27:1-7; 31:1-6; 2 Samuel 1:26; 3:1-21; 5:1-10; 1 Ateptab Betusiek 11:1-9. Teebutik che Kineetengei

KINGO kagonaam Daudi kolaitoran eng’ Jerusalem, kotoret Jehovah bikyik che bo boriet kosindan bunikab Israel. Kiga komwachi Jehovah Israelik kole igochin emetab Kanan, ago ki toret konyor emonoto tugul.

Ki laitoriat ne kararan Daudi ago ki chamei Jehovah. Ko u noto, kit ne tai ne ki yai kingo kagonam Jerusalem, ko kigeer kole kagiib moingetab kayonjinet ne bo Jehovah konyo Jerusalem. Ago ki machei kora koteech hekalut si konde moingonoto.

Mi kit ne ya ne kiyai Daudi kingo kagoeet. Kiingen Daudi komie kole ya keib kiy ne ma neng’ung’. Nga u noto, ko mi betut agenge ne kiwendoti Daudi eng’ baragutab gonnyi, kogeer kwondo ne kararan ne bo kwong’ut komwetegei anan kounigei. Ki kiguure kwonyoto Bat-seba ago boiyondennyin ko ki kiguure Uria ago ki agenge eng’ askarikab Daudi.

Kimach Daudi Bat-seba ne bo kwong’ut kot koit koyookto kimutyi konyo gonnyin. Ki mi boriet manong’otiondennyi kasarata. Ko ruiyo anyun Daudi ak Bat-seba ago kiek tamono kwonyoto. Kiarogen Daudi ne bo kwong’ut ak koyookto kelenji Joab ne kiindochin bikab boriet konde Uria tai eng’ boriet si kobiit kebar. Kingome Uria kotun Daudi Bat-seba.

Ki nerech Jehovah ne bo kwong’ut eng’ kit ne ki yai Daudi. Koyookto anyun kiboitiondennyi ne kiguure Natan kwo komwachi Daudi agobo tengektanyi. Kiimgei Daudi mising’ agobo kit ne ki yai, ko u noto ko ma bar Jehovah Daudi. Kolenji Jehovah Daudi: ‘Amu koiyai tuguchu yaach, inyoru kaimutik che chang’ eng’ gong’ung’.’ Ago ki nyor kaimutik iman Daudi!

Kaimutiet ne tai, ko ki me weritab Bat-seba. Ye ibata, konam Amnon tupchennyin ne chepto ne kiguure Tamar ko mi inegei ak kosuub, Amnon ko ki weritab Daudi ne tai. Ki nerech weritab Daudi ne keguure Absalom mising’ kot kobar Amnon. Ki ye siirto kasarta, ko cham bik che chang’ Absalom. Koberber Absalom bik konde inendet koek laitoriat. Ki yai nito kobiit boriet eng’ Absalom ak Daudi ago ki eng’ let kebar Absalom ak kosindonis Daudi. Eng’ iman ko kinyor kaimutik che chang’ Daudi.

Kingo tesetai tuguchuto tugul, kosich Bat-seba werit ne kiguure Solomon. Kingo yoosit Daudi, kotiem Adonija koyai gei koek laitoriat. Ki ye nai nito Daudi, koguur tisiindet ne kiguure Sadok konyo koiil Solomon koek laitoriat. Kisiirto kasarta kitigin, ko me Daudi ko bo kenyisiek 70 ago kiga kolaitoran eng’ Israel kenyisiek 40. Kiinaam anyun Solomon kolaitoran.2 Samuel 11:1-27; 12:1-18; 1 Laitorinik 1:1-48. Teebutik che Kineetengei

KIEK Solomon laitoriat ko ta ko ming’in. Ki chamei Solomon Jehovah ago kiisubi kotigonetab kwandanyi Daudi. Amu ki boibochi Jehovah Solomon, kolenji kemout agenge eng’ karwotitoet: ‘Solomon, imache agonin nee?’

Kowol Solomon kole: ‘Jehovah Kamuktaindennyun, a ming’in ago mongen andochi bik. Ko u noto, asomin igono ng’omnatet si kobiit andochi biguk eng’ oret ne kararan.’

Ki boibochi Jehovah kit ne ki som Solomon. Ko u noto, kolenji Jehovah Solomon: ‘Amu kesom ng’omnatet ama isom imeng’isie kenyisiek che chang’ anan ko magornatosiek, agonin ng’omnatet ne siirei ne bo chi tugul. Ago agonin kora tuguk che ma iteebena, choto ko magornatosiek ak torornatet.’

Kingo siirto kasarta ne ma tia, kobwa kwonyik aeng’u che ki tinyei kaimutiet ne o. Kole kwondo ne tai: ‘Kimenye got agenge ak kwonyi. Ki asich lakwet ne werit, ago kingo kagobata betusiek aeng’u kosich agine lakwet ne werit. Ki me lakwennyi besio kemoi. Ko kingo ta arue, konam lakwennyi ne kagome ak komogoon eng’ ole ami ak komut lakwennyun. Ki ye ang’eet, ageer ale ma nenyu lakwet ne kagome.’

Kole kwonyin age: ‘Achicha! Nenyu lakwet ne sobei, ko bo kwonyi lakwet ne kagome!’ Kole kwondo ne tai: ‘Achicha! Neng’ung’ lakwet ne kagome ko nenyu ne sobei!’ Ki ng’ichgei anan ki tiiyo kwonyichoto ko u noto. Ara ki ta yae nee Solomon?

Kiiyookto Solomon keipchi rotwet, kingo kageipchi komwa kole: ‘Pchei lakwanito koek aeng’ ak igochi kwondo age tugul kebeberiat.’ Kole kametab lakwet: ‘Acha! Kaigai mat obar lakwet, ogochin kwonyi!’ Kole kwonyin age: ‘Mat ogochi age tugul eng’ echek lakwet, opchei koek aeng’.’

Kole Solomon anyun: ‘Mat obar lakwet! Ogochi kwondo ne tai amu inendet kametab lakwet.’ Ki nai Solomon nito amu kametab lakwet ko chamei lakwennyin, iyani agot kogochi kwonyin age amu ma machei kebar. Kingo kas bik kit ne kayai Solomon, koboiboitu amu ki nai kole tinyei laitoriat ne ng’om.

Eng’ kasarta ne ki laitorani Solomon Israel, ko ki iberur Jehovah bik amu ki akwaitu mbarenik koruryo nganuk, sabibuk, mogoonik ak amitwogik alak. Ki menyei bik gorik che kororon ak kolachi ngoroik che kororon. Ki imuchi konyor bik tugul kiy age tugul ne kararan.1 Laitorinik 3:3-28; 4:25-34. Teebutik che Kineetengei

KINGO tomo kome Daudi, koarorji Solomon agobo ole kiteektoi hekalutab Jehovah ko u ye kigamwa Kamuktaindet. Kiinaam anyun Solomon koteech hekalut eng’ kenyitab ang’wan ne bo laitornatennyin ago kiib kenyisiek tisab ak nusu si kotar teekset. Ki chang’ bik ne bo kwong’ut che ki teeksei ago kigiboisie rabinik che chang’ mising’ eng’ teeksonoto. Kiib robisiek che chang’ amu kigiboisie tahabu ak fedaisiek.

Ki tinyei hekalut rumisiek aeng’ ko u ye ki u emaitab Jehovah ne kigisaee. Nga u noto, ko ki nyilen aeng’ rumisiechuto chu ki bo emaitab Jehovah. Kiinde Solomon moingetab kayonjinet rumit ne bo orit eng’ hekalut.

Kingorook hekalut, kochob Solomon igoorto ne o. Ki kutuny Solomon anyun eng’ taitab hekalut ak kosa ko u ye igeere eng’ pichaini. Ki sa kole: ‘Ma yamin agot kipsengwet itebee, ko ming’in anyun ne tia hekaluni. Ara asomin Ee Kamuktaindennyu, kaigai kas saetab biguk ye sae kotakyingei goi.’

Kingo tar Solomon kosae, kochoorgei mat eng’ kipsengwet. Kobeel kagochinet ne kiga kichob ak konyi got lilindab Jehovah. Kiiboor nito kole ki kasei Jehovah saetab Solomon ago kiboibochi hekalut. Kiinaam anyun bik kobwa kosae hekalut ne kata emait. Ki laitoran Solomon kenyisiek che chang’ eng’ oret ne kararan ago ki boiboitu bik. Nga u noto, ko kiitun Solomon kwonyik che chang’ che ki bunu emotinwek che ki ma koboisiechin Jehovah. Tos igeere agenge eng’ kwonyichoto kosae cheptalelit eng’ pichait? Ki eng’ let, koberber chepyosochoto Solomon koboisiechi cheptalelisiek agine. Ingen kit ne ki yaak kingoboisiechi cheptalelisiek Solomon? Kiinaam koyait ago ma ta koriree bik ak ko kolgolit. Ki yai nito ma ta koboibochi bik laitornatennyi.

Ki nerekyi Jehovah Solomon ak kolenji: ‘Arebenen bounatoni ak agochi chito age. Ma rebenen ko ta isobe, agochini chito age kolaitorani wering’ung’. Nga u noto, ko marebee wering’ung’ bik tugul che bo laitornatennyi.’ Ngegeer anyun kit ne kiyaak.1 Ateptab Betusiek 28:9-21; 29:1-9; 1 Laitorinik 5:1-18; 2 Ateptab Betusiek 6:12-42; 7:1-5; 1 Laitorinik 11:9-13. Teebutik che Kineetengei

TOS ingen amu nee si kogereri ngoriet chichi? Kilenji Jehovah kogerer. Chichito ko maotiotab Kamuktaindet ne kiguure Aija. Ingen ile maotiot ko ng’o? Maotiot ko chito ne mwachin Jehovah tuguk che tomo koyaak.

Tos igeere Aija kong’alajin Jeroboam eng’ pichait? Jeroboam ko chito ne ki kainde Solomon kotelelji boisietab teekset. Kingotuiyo Aija ak Jeroboam eng’ oret, koyai Aija kiy ne bo kwong’ut. Kiirek ngoriennyi ne leel ak kogerer koek kebeberwek 12 ak kolenji Jeroboam: ‘Ib kebeberwek 10.’ Tos ingen amu nee si kogochi Aija Jeroboam kebeberwek 10?

Kimwa Aija kole reben Jehovah Solomon bounatet ak kogochi Jeroboam bororiosiek 10. Ibooru nito kole, ng’etyin weritab Solomon ne kiguure Reoboam bororiosiek aeng’u kityo.

Kingo kas Solomon kit ne kimwachi Aija Jeroboam, konerech ne bo kwong’ut. Ki tiem kobar Jeroboam. Koyai nito komwei Jeroboam kwo Misri. Kingosiirto kasarta, kome Solomon. Kiga kolaitoran kenyisiek 40, keyai anyun werinnyin Reoboam koek laitoriat. Kingomi Jeroboam Misri, kogas kole kogome Solomon, koweektagei Israel.

Ki ma ko laitoriat ne mie Reoboam. Ki ya kosiir kwandanyi Solomon. Ki wo anyun Jeroboam koboto bik alak che eechen kolenji Reoboam kowalak mat ko ta koyait eng’ bik. Nga u noto, ko ma kas Reoboam, ki yait agot mising’. Ko u noto koyai bik Jeroboam koek laitoriat ne bo bororiosiek 10. Nga u noto, ko kilewen bororiosiekab Benjamin ak Juda kotestai koek Reoboam laitoriandennywa.

Ma machei Jeroboam ko ba bik Jerusalem koot Jehovah eng’ hekalut. Ko u noto, kochob moek aeng’ che bo tahabu ak koberber bikab bororiosiek 10 kosa moechoto. Ma siirto kasarta ne o konyi yaitiet emet.

Mi kaimutiet kora bounatetab bororiosiek aeng’. Ma beg kenyisiek mutu kong’eete ngoek Reoboam laitoriat, konyo laitoriatab Misri kobargei ak bikab Jerusalem. Kiib tuguk che chang’ che bo kamanut eng’ hekalutab Jehovah. Ibooru noto kole ki tebi hekalut ko u ole kiga kiteekta kasarta kitigin kityo.1 Laitorinik 11:26-43; 12:1-33; 14:21-31. Teebutik che Kineetengei

KINGO kagome Jeroboam, ko laitoriat age tugul ne kiisub eng’ bounatetab bororiosiek 10 ko ki ya. Laitoriat ne ki ya eng’ tugul ko ki Ahab. Tos ingen amu nee? Amu nee agenge, ko kwondanyi ne ya ne kiguure Jesebel.

Jesebel ko ki ma ko cheptab Israel, ki cheptab laitoriatab Sidon. Ki saei cheptalelit ne kiguure Baal, ago kiiberber kora Ahab ak Israelik alak kosa cheptalelinoto. Ki sasei Jesebel Jehovah ago ki bar maotikab Jehovah che chang’. Ki yaach agot kounygei alak eng’ kebenosiek si ma bar Jesebel. Jesebel ko ki kwondo ne kingo machei kiy, ko kiimuchi agot kobar chito si konyor kioto.

Ki mi betut agenge ne kiimegei Laitoriat Ahab ne bo kwong’ut. Koteebe Jesebel kolenji: ‘Amu nee si iimegei ra?’

Kowol Ahab kole: ‘Aiimegei amu kit ne kamwawa Nabot, kamache aal mbarennyi ne bo sabibuk, kolenjon ma aldewon.’

Kolenji Jesebel: ‘Meiimngei, inyoru mbaranoto.’

Ki sirta baronok anyun Jesebel kosirji boisiek che togunotin che ki mi nganaset ne ki menyei Nabot. Ki sirji kolenji: ‘Ocheng’ bik ak olenji kotaam anan komwa lembech kole kachub Nabot Kamuktaindet ak laitoriat, ye ibata omut Nabot komanda sang’ eng’ nganaset ak olach eng’ koik kome.’

Kingo nai Jesebel kole kagome Nabot, kolenji Ahab: ‘Ui anyun ib mbarennyi ne bo sabibuk.’ Tos meyoni ile ki nyolu kegerkong’ Jesebel eng’ kioto ya kigayai?

Kiiyookto anyun Jehovah chito ne kiguure Jeu kwo kogerkong’ Jesebel. Kingo kas Jesebel kole nyonei Jeu, kosal konyekyik ak kochobochobgei kogararanit. Nga u noto, ko kingoit Jeu, kogeer komi Jesebel tirisha, koguur murenik che ki mi ak Jesebel kolenji: ‘Owirun Jesebel konyo ng’ony!’ Ki kas it anyun bichoto ak kowirta Jesebel ko u ye igeere eng’ pichait. Ki me Jesebel ago kiek let nenyi noto.1 Laitorinik 16:29-33; 18:1-4; 21:1-16; 2 Laitorinik 9:30-37. Teebutik che Kineetengei

TOS ingen ile ng’o bichu? Ago tos yae nee? Bendi boriet, ago bichu mi tai ko tiendos. Nga u noto, imuch iteebengei ile: ‘Amu nee si ma tinyei bichu tiendos rotonik ak ng’otwek?’ Ngegeer amu nee.

Jeosapat ko laitoriat ne bo bororiosiek aeng’ che bo Israel. Ki meng’isiei kasarta agenge ak laitoriat ne kiguure Ahab ak kwondanyi Jesebel. Ahab ko ki laitoriatab bororiosiek 10 che bo murot katam. Nga u noto, ko Jeosapat ko ki laitoriat ne mie, agot kwandanyi Asa ko ki laitoriat ne ki mie agine. Ko u noto, ko ki boibochi sobet ne kararan eng’ kenyisiek che chang’ bikab bororiosiek aeng’ che bo murot tai.

Mi anyun kit ne kiyaak ne kiigochi bik koarogenso. Kibwa bik ak kolenji Jeosapat: ‘Bwanei bikab luget che bunu emotinwekab Moab, Amon ak Tulwetab Seir kobookyinin anan obargei.’ Kiiyumgei anyun Israelik che chang’ eng’ Jerusalem kocheng’ toretetab Jehovah. Ki ba agoi hekalut, ak kosa Jeosapat kole: ‘Ee Jehovah Kamuktaindennyo, ma kingen kele kiyae nee. Ma kimuchi kebargei ak bichu chang’. Kisome itoretech.’

Kigas Jehovah saetab Jeosapat ak kolenji kiboitiondennyi agenge komwachi bik kole: ‘Ma neng’wong’ luget, bo Jehovah. Moyae kiy. Otononse kityo ak ogeer ole sorundok Jehovah.’

Ki betut ne rubei, kolenji Jeosapat bik: ‘Omaang’u Jehovah!’ Kiinde bik che tiendos anyun taitab bikyik che bo luget, ak ye kingo bendi, kotieni tienwogik che iloosu Jehovah. Tos ingen kit ne kiyaak kingo rikyi ole kibaregei? Ki yai Jehovah kobargei bunikab Israel ichegei eng’ ichegei. Ki ye it Israelik yoto, ko kiga kobeg bunik tugul!

Ki ng’omit ne tia Jeosapat komoong’ Jehovah! Bo kamanut kimaang’u Jehovah ak echek.1 Laitorinik 22:41-53; 2 Ateptab Betusiek 20:1-30. Teebutik che Kineetengei

NDO imee, ko tos kasta ano kameng’ung’ ngot king’eetin isob kogeny? Boiboitu ne bo kwong’ut! Nga u noto, ko tos imugaksei iman kosob chito ne kagome? Tos ki koyaaksei ko u noto?

Keer bichu mi pichaini. Chichi ko maotiot ne kiguree Elija, ko kwonyi ko mosoget ne bunu nganasetab Sarepat ago nenyi lakwani. Ki mian mising’ lakwani betut agenge kot kome. Kolenji Elija kwonyoto: ‘Kono wering’ung’.’

Kiimut anyun Elija lakwet kwo goroba barak ak konde koru eng’ kitogut ak kosa kole: ‘Ee Jehovah, ingosob lakwani.’ Kiinaam kobuus lakwet! Konam anyun Elija ak komut kwo ole mi kamet ak kolenji kamet: ‘Keer o, kagosob wering’ung’!’ Nito amu nee si ko baibai kamennyi ne bo kwong’ut!

Maotiot age ne bo kamanut ne bo Jehovah keguure Elisha ago inendet ko toretindetab Elija. Kingo kagosiirto kasarta, koboisien Jehovah Elisha koyai kwong’utik. Ki wo Elisha betut agenge nganasetab Sunem ole kinyor kwondo ne ki mie. Kingo kagobata kasarta, kosich kwonyoto ak manong’otiondennyin werit.

Besio kingo kagoeet lakwanato, kwo koyai boisiet ak kwandanyin eng’ mbar. Kingo ta komi mbar kolenji lakwanato kwanda: ‘Ama metit!’ Kingo ka kimut kwo gaa, kome. Kiimgei ne bo kwong’ut kamennyin, ak kwo sainoto koguur Elisha.

Kingoit Elisha, komut lakwet ne kagome kwo rumit orit. Ki sa anyun Elisha Jehovah ak koruee bortab lakwet. Kiinaam anyun ko lalang’it bortab lakwet ak koriony konyil tisab. Ki baibait kamet ne tia kingo nyo go ak konyor lakwennyin kosobei!

Kigobeg bik che chang’ ago kigoyai noto koimgei bikwak ak choronokwak mising’. Ma kitinyei kimnatet king’eet bik che kigo beg nga u noto, ko tinyei Jehovah kimnatet. Ta kinetigei ole nyo kong’eetitoi Jehovah bik che chang’ che kigobeg.1 Laitorinik 17:8-24; 2 Laitorinik 4:8-37. Teebutik che Kineetengei

data.titulo: Chepto ne ki Toret Chi ne O
data.contenido:
TOS ingen kit ne mwae lakwani ming’in? Mwachin kwonyi agobo maotiotab Jehovah ne kiguure Elisha, ak tuguk che bo kwong’ut che toreti Jehovah Elisha koyai. Ma ingen kwonyi Jehovah amu ma bo Israel. Ngegeer amu nee si ko mi lakwani gotab kwonyito.

Bunu emetab Suria kwonyi, ago manong’otiondennyin keguure Naaman, ne o ne bo lugetab Suria. Kiganam bikab Suria lakwani bo Israel ak komut kwo koek otwogindetab kwondab Naaman.

Tinyei Naaman miondo ne ya ne kiguree mogondosik. Imuchi koam mionito banyekab borto. Ko u noto, komwachin lakwani kwondab Naaman kole: ‘Ndo wendi kiptayandennyun Israel konyor maotiotab Jehovah, konyooi miondonyin.’ Ki kimwachi anyun Naaman ng’alechoto.

Amu machei Naaman kinya ne bo kwong’ut, kogeer kole kaigai kwo agoi gotab Elisha eng’ Israel. Kingoit oloto, koyookto Elisha otwogindennyin kolenji Naaman kwo Ainetab Jordan ak komwetgei anan koun gei konyil tisab. Kingo kas ko u noto Naaman, konerech ne bo kwong’ut ak kole: ‘Koigoi ainosiek tugul che mi gaa kosiir ainet age tugul ne mi Israel!’ Kingo kagomwa ko u nito, kwo.

Kolenji anyun otwogindennyin agenge: ‘Kiptayandennyun, ndo kagalenjin Elisha iyai kit ne ui, ko ka ta iyae. Ara anyun, kalya me yan iun gei ko u ye kamwaun?’ Ki kas anyun Naaman ng’alekab otwogindennyin ak kwo komwetgei konyil tisab eng’ Ainetab Jordan. Kingo yai ko u noto kosob ak kogararanit bortanyi!

Ki baibait Naaman mising’. Koweek anyun ak kolenji Elisha: ‘Kaanai iman ale Kamuktaindet ne mi Israel ko Kamuktaindet ne bo iman eng’ ng’ony komugul. Ko u noto, amache agonin konunotiondoni, kaigai nam.’ Kolenji Elisha: ‘Ma name’. Ingen komie Elisha kole ngot ko nam konunotiondonoto ko ya amu ki Jehovah ne ki inyooi Naaman. Nga u noto, komachei otwogindetab Elisha ne kiguure Geasi konunotiondonoto.

Koyai anyun Geasi ko u ni. Kingo ka kwo Naaman, kolabat kosub. Kingoityi kolenji: ‘Kaiyookwo Elisha alenjin igochi konunotiot si kogochi choronokyik che kabwa korutochi inendet.’ Eng’ iman ko lembech nito. Nga u noto, ko ma ingen Naaman kole lembech nito, kogochi anyun Naaman Geasi konunotoik.

Kingoweek gaa Geasi, ko kiga konai Elisha kit ne kayai amu kimwachi Jehovah. Kolenji Elisha Geasi: ‘Amu keyai kiito ya, ko namin mogondosikab Naaman.’ Ago ki yaak ko u noto sainoto!

Tos ineteech nee nito? Ne tai, ko nyolu keamde agobo Jehovah ko u chepi ming’in amu mie keyai ko u noto. Ne bo aeng’, ko ma nyolu kemen ko u Naaman, nyolu ke kas it kiboitinikab Jehovah. Ne bo somok, ko ma nyolu kemwa lembech ko u Geasi. Chang’ tuguk che kinetigei eng’ Bibilia, tos ma iman?2 Laitorinik 5:1-27. Teebutik che Kiteebengei

TOS igeere chichi mi beek orit? Negit kolugui samakiat! Tos ingen ile ng’o chichi? Kiguure Jona. Ngegeer amu nee si ko mi beek orit.

Jona ko maotiotab Jehovah. Ma siirto kasarta ne o kong’eete ngome Elisha, kolenji Jehovah Jona: ‘Ui nganasetab Ninebe. Kogoeet yaitietab bik ago amache iwe ing’alalji agobo noto.’

Nga u noto, ko ma mach Jona kwo. Kolany anyun melit ak kwo komosta age ne ma Ninebe. Ma boibochi Jehovah kingomwei Jona, ko u noto, koyai kobiit usonet ne o eng’ nyanjet. Ki eet usonet mising’ kot ko ki ta ibut melit. Koarogenso ne bo kwong’ut bik che ki mi melit orit ak konaam kosa cheptalelisiekwak kosom toretet. Ki eng’ let kolenji Jona bichoto: ‘Ane aboisiechini Jehovah, Kamuktaindet ne ki yae kipsengwet ak ng’ony. Ami amween boisiet ne kogona Jehovah ayai.’ Keteebe anyun Jona kelenji: ‘Ara kiiten nee anan kilyonjin si kobiit kosis usonet?’

Kowol Jona kole: ‘Owirjo beek orit, si kosis usonet.’ Ki ma komachei bichoto kowirji Jona beek orit, nga u noto, ko ki ye testai kogoromit usonet, koyaach kowirji. Ki sis usonet sainoto ak kigararanit nyanjet kogeny.

Kingo mi beek orit Jona, kolugui samakiat ne o, nga u noto ko ma me Jona. Ki tebee moetab samakiat orit betusiek somok bet ak kemoi. Kiimgei Jona mising’ amu ma kas it Jehovah kingolenji kwo Ninebe. Ara anyun tos ingen ile ki yai nee?

Ki som Jona Jehovah toretet, kong’ung’ samakiat Jona eng’ emet ne yamaat. Ki ye ibata noto, kwo anyun Jona Ninebe. Tos ma ineteech nito kole bo kamanut kegas it Jehovah?Bukuitab Jona eng’ Bibilia. Teebutik che Kineetengei

NI KO pichaitab paradiso ne kiga iboorji Kamuktaindet maotiondennyi ne kiguure Isaia. Ki maotiot Isaia ne kiisubi Jona.

Paradiso ko “mbaret” anan “kabungut” ne kararan. Tos ibwatun nito kiy ne kiga igeere eng’ bukuini? Kergei mbarani ak mbaret ne kararan ne kiga chobchi Jehovah Kamuktaindet Adam ak Awa, tos ma iman? Ara anyun, tos tun imugaksei koek ng’ony tugul paradiso iman?

Kilenji Jehovah maotiondennyi Isaia kosir agobo paradiso ne nyonei ne bo bikab Kamuktaindet. Kile: ‘Tun tebyei suiyot ak kechirek eng’ kalyet. Tun agetos moek ak ng’etunyik ak koribei ichek lagok che mengech. Tun ko ma itoi kiy erenet ne tinyei sumu lakwet agot ndo chesan eng’ ole negite.’

Imuchi komwa bik alak kole: ‘Ma imugaksei nito. Ki mi kaimutik ng’ony kong’eete ago tesetai kobiitu.’ Nga u noto, ko nyolu iteebengei ile: Kiga igochi Jehovah Adam ak Awa mbaret ne u nee?

Kiga inde Jehovah Adam ak Awa paradiso. Amu ma kas it Adam ak Awa Jehovah, komanda eng’ mbaret ne kararan, kiinaam anyun koosegitu ak kobeg. Kimwa Kamuktaindet kole ta tun kogochin bik che chamei inendet tuguk che kororon che kiibet Adam ak Awa.

Tun ko ma ko mi kiy ne iimei chi eng’ paradiso. Ta tun ko mi kalyet, tun ko boiboi bik ak kotinyei chametabgei ne bo borwek. Tun koyaaksei ko u ole kimaktoi Jehovah eng’ taunet. Ta kinetigei agobo ole tun yaitoi Kamuktaindet ng’ony koek paradiso.Isaia 11:6-9; Ng’ang’utiet 21:3, 4. Teebutik che Kiteebengei

TOS ingen amu nee si ko sae chichi mi pichaini? Ago amu nee si koiito baronok eng’ taitab kaptisisio ne bo Jehovah? Kiguure chichito Hesekia, ago inendet ko laitoriatab bororosiek aeng’ che bo murot tai eng’ Israel. Iimegei chichi ne bo kwong’ut. Tos ingen amu nee si koimegei?

Iimegei amu kogong’em lugetab Asuria bororosiek 10 che bo murot katam eng’ Israel. Ki chamda Jehovah koyaak ko u noto amu ki yaach bichoto ne bo kwong’ut ago nguni ko bwanei lugetab Asuria kobaregei ak bounatetab bororosiek aeng’ che bo Israel.

Kagoyookyi laitoriatab Asuria Hesekia baronaik. Chuto baronok che igeere kaiito Hesekia eng’ taitab Jehovah. Eng’ baronaichuto ko kachub laitoriatab Asuria Jehovah ak kolenji Hesekia kogon gei. Noto amu nee si kosa Hesekia kole: ‘Ee Jehovah, saruech eng’ laitoriatab Asuria. Si kobiit konai bororosiek tugul kole, inyegei Kamuktaindet.’ Ara anyun tos kas Jehovah saetab Hesekia?

Hesekia ko laitoriat ne mie. Ma u laitorinik che yaach che bo bororiosiek 10 eng’ Israel, ago ma u kwandanyi Laitoriat Ahas ne ki ya. Ki kogiilgei Hesekia ko kas it ng’atutik tugul che bo Jehovah. Ko u noto, ko kingo kagotar Hesekia kosae, koyookyi Isaia Hesekia logoiywek che bunu Jehovah kole: ‘Ma chutu laitoriatab Asuria Jerusalem. Ma rigu agot kitigin bikyik che bo luget ago ma mwagen agot kipchabet agenge nganasani.’ Keer pichaini mi pechini, tos ingen ile ng’o bichu kagobek tugul? Chuto ko askarikab Asuria. Kiiyook Jehovah malaikaiyannyi kobar askarikab Asuria 185,000 eng’ kemout agenge. Kingo keer laitoriatab Asuria, kogon ge kityo ak koweektagei gaa.

Kigisor bounatonito bo bororiosiek aeng’, konyor anyun bik kalyet kitigin. Ki me Hesekia ago kiek werinnyi ne keguure Manase laitoriat. Ki laitorinik che yaach ne bo kwong’ut Manase ak werinnyi Laitoriat Amon ne kiisubi inendet eng’ laitornatet. Kiinaam konyi yaitiet emet kogeny. Ki ye bar kiboitinikyik Amon, koek werinnyi ne keguure Josia laitoriat ne bo bounatetab bororiosiek aeng’.2 Laitorinik 18:1-36; 19:1-37; 21:1-25. Teebutik che Kineetengei

data.titulo: Laitoriat ne Mie ne bo Let eng’ Israel
data.contenido:
KI BO kenyisiek sisit kityo Josia kingonaami kolaitorani bororiosiek aeng’ che bo murot tai eng’ Israel. Ki ta ko ming’in ne bo kwong’ut kingo egu laitoriat, ko u noto eng’ tai, ko kitoret boisiek che eechen kolaitoran emet.

Kingo kagolaitoran Josia kenyisiek tisab, konaam kocheng’ Jehovah. Ki yai inendet ko u Daudi, Jeosapat ak Hesekia, che ki laitorinik che miach. Kingo ta ko neran Josia anyun, koyai kiy ne kiiboor nyiganatet.

Kiga koyaagitu ne bo kwong’ut Israelik che chang’ eng’ kasarta ne koi. Ki sae cheptalelisiek ak kogutung’jin kanamonik. Ki ba anyun Josia ak bikyik koisto kanamonik eng’ emet. Ki ma ko nyumnyum boisionoto amu ki chang’ bik che ki boisiechin cheptalelisiek. Tos igeere Josia ak bikyik kong’emei kanamonik eng’ pichait?

Ki ye ibata nito, kolewen Josia murenik somok kotononji boisietab kechob ole kigobutok eng’ hekalutab Jehovah. Kigiyum robisiek ak kigochi murenichuto si kobiit kolibane bik che kiyae boisiet. Kingo ta ko boisiei Hilkia tisiindet ne o eng’ hekalut, konyor kit ne bo kamanut ne bo kwong’ut. Kinyor bukuitab ng’atutik ne kiga kobet, ne kigalenji Jehovah Musa kosir eng’ kenyisiek che chang’ che kiga kosiirto.

Kigiibchi anyun Josia bukuinoto. Kingeibchi kosom kesomanji, kigas anyun ak kigeer kole kagaa ki ma ta koribei bik ng’atutikab Jehovah. Kiimgei mising’ agobo nito ak kogerer ngoriennyi ko u ye igeere eng’ pichait. Kimwa kole: ‘Ki konerekyech Jehovah amu ma rib kwanisiekyok ng’atutik che mi bukuini.’ Kiiyookto Josia Hilkia kwo konai kit ne nyo koyachin Jehovah bik. Ki wo anyun Hilkia koteebe kwondo ne kiguure Hulda ne ki maotiot. Kolenji Hulda anyun Hilkia kwo komwachi Josia ng’alechu bunu Jehovah: ‘Amu kogoboisiechi cheptalelisiek bik ago ko konyi emet yaitiet, konyoru birutiet Jerusalem ak bik tugul. Nga u noto, ko amu iyae ne mie Josia, ko ma yaaksei tuguchu ko ta i sobe.’2 Ateptab Betusiek 34:1-28. Teebutik che Kiteebengei

KEER bichu mi pichaini, rorechin chichi ng’alali. Tos ingen ile ng’o chichito? Kiguure Jeremia, inendet ko maotiotab Kamuktaindet.

Kingonaam kityo Laitoriat Josia kong’em kanamonik eng’ emet, kolenji Jehovah Jeremia koek maotiondennyi. Nga u noto, ko kiibwati Jeremia kole ki ta ko ming’in mising’ ago ki magoi imuch koek maotiot. Kolenji Jehovah Jeremia toreti inendet.

Kilenji Jeremia anyun bik kometo tuguk che yaach. Kimwa kole: ‘Ma bo iman cheptalelisiek che boisiechin bikab bororiosiek.’ Nga u noto, ko kigeer bik kole kaigai koboisiechi kanamonik ne ka ta Jehovah Kamuktaindet. Kilenji Jeremia bik nyonei Jehovah kong’emei ichek kosubgei ak yaitiennywa. Kingo kas bik ko u noto, kororechi Jeremia.

Kiit kasarta ne ki me Josia, ago kingobata arawek somogu koek laitoriat werinnyi ne keguure Jeoiakim. Ki testai Jeremia komwachi bik kole: ‘King’emei Jerusalem ngot ko mowal atebosiekwok che yaach.’ Ki nam anyun tisiik Jeremia ak kolenji: ‘Nyolu kebarin kosubgei ak ng’alechu kemwa.’ Ki mwachi tisiik kora bounik kole: ‘Nyolu kebar Jeremia amu komwaitae nganasennyo tuguk che yaach.’

Ara si koyai nee Jeremia ng’uno? Ma arogen agot kitigin! Ko u noto, kolenji Jeremia bichoto tugul: ‘Kiiyookwo Jehovah amwawok tuguchu. Ngot ko mowal atebosiekwok che yaach, kong’emei Jehovah Jerusalem. Ak amache onai ni: Ngot obara, ko kobar chi ne ma tinyei lelut.’

Ma bar bounik Jeremia, nga u noto, ko ma wal Israelik atebosiekwak che yaachen. Kingobata kasarta, konyo Nebukadnesar laitoriatab Babulon kobargei ak bikab Jerusalem. Ki eng’ let, koyai Nebukadnesar koek Israelik kiboitinikyik ak komut alak che chang’ koba Babulon. Ibwat ko u ni, ndo namin bik che mengen ak komutin agoi emet ne mengen, igastoi ano?Jeremia 1:1-8; 10:1-5; 26:1-16; 2 Laitorinik 24:1-17. Teebutik che Kineetengei

KI NAM laitoriatab Babulon ne keguure Nebukadnesar Israelik tugul che ki somaniotin ak komut koba Babulon. Ki lewen Nebukadnesar eng’ Israelichoto murenik che mengech, che ng’omen ago che tinyei iton ne kararan kosiir tugul. Ang’wan eng’ murenichoto ko chu igeere eng’ pichait. Agenge keguure Daniel, ko alak somok ko kiigochi bikab Babulon kainaik che kiguure Sadrak, Mesak ak Abed-nego.

Machei Nebukadnesar koneet murenik che ta ko mengech si kobiit kobois eng’ gonnyi. Ye kagoneet kenyisiek somok, kolewen che ng’omen mising’ eng’ ichek si kobiit kotoret inendet yon tinyei kaimutik. Machei laitoriat ko kimegitu werichuto ak konyor borwek che miach ye kitesetai kineti. Kiigochi anyun kiboitinikyik ng’atutiet kole kogochi tugul amitwogik ak divaik che kergei ak che amei inendet ak bikab gonnyi.

Tos igeere Daniel eng’ pichait, ago tos ingen ile mwachin nee ne o ne bo kiboitinikab Nebukadnesar ne kiguure Aspenas? Lenjin ma amei amitwogikab laitoriat amu ma machei komuruon ge eng’ amitwogichoto. Kiimngei Aspenas ak kolenji Daniel: ‘Kagomwa laitoriat kit ne nyolu oam ak oee, ago ngot ko ma kororonegitu borwekwok ko u che bo murenchun alak, komuch kobaran laitoriat.’

Ki wo anyun Daniel konyor ribindet ne kiga lewen Aspenas koriib inendet ak choronokyik alak somok ak kolenji: ‘Tiemech, konech ngwek ak beek che kiee kityo. Ye ibata betusiek 10, igeerjine borwekyok ak che bo werik alak che amei amitwogikab laitoriat si igeer ile ng’o che kororon borwek.’

Kiiyan anyun ribindet koyai ko u noto. Kingobeg betusiek 10, kotook Daniel ak choronokyik somok ko tinyei borwek che kororon kosiir werik alak che kiamei amitwogikab laitoriat. Ko u noto, ko testai anyun ribindonoto kogochi ngwek ne kata amitwogikab laitoriat.

Kingobeg kenyisiek somogu, kimutyi murenchoto tugul Nebukadnesar. Kingo kago ng’alalji laitoriat murenchuto tugul, kotook Daniel ak choronokyik somok ko ng’omen kosiir tugul. Ko u noto, kole laitoriat kong’et werichoto ang’wanu si kobiit kotoret eng’ gonnyi. Ki kasarta age tugul ne kateebe laitoriat teebut age tugul anan ko kaimutiet age tugul Daniel, Sadrak, Mesak ak Abed-nego, ko kiingen konyil 10 walutik murenchoto kosiir tisiik ak bik che ng’omen che bo laitoriat.Daniel 1:1-21. Teebutik che Kineetengei

KI KOBEG kenyisiek 10 kong’etee ngonam Laitoriat Nebukadnesar Israelik tugul che somaniotin ak komut koba Babulon. Keer anyun kit ne yaaksei eng’ pichait. Kibeelei Jerusalem, ak kimuti Israelik che ma kibar koba kerat eng’ Babulon.

Ibwat ile kiga iteechi maotikab Jehovah bik agobo kit ne yaaksei ngot ko ma wal bik ortinwekwak che yaach. Nga u noto, ko magas Israelik kit ne kimwachi maotik. Ki testai kosa cheptalelisiek ne ka ta Jehovah. Ko u noto, ko ki nyolu kegerkong’ bichoto. Kingen nito amu mwawech maotiotab Jehovah ne keguure Esekiel agobo tuguk che yaach che ki yae Israelik.

Tos ingen ile Esekiel ko ng’o? Ki agenge eng’ murenik che kiga imut Nebukadnesar koba Babulon kenyisiek che siirei 10 kotomo koit ng’emetab Jerusalem. Ki kagimut kora Daniel ak choronokyik somok, Sadrak, Mesak ak Abed-nego koba Babulon kasarata.

Kingo ta komi Esekiel Babulon, koboorji Jehovah tuguk che yaach che ki yaaksei eng’ hekalut eng’ Jerusalem. Ki boisiee Jehovah kwong’utiet koboorji Esekiel tuguchoto. Ki yai Jehovah Esekiel kogeer kiy age tugul ne ki tesetai eng’ hekalut. Kigeerei Esekiel tuguchuto komi Babulon, ago kigeer tuguk che yaach ne bo kwong’ut!

Kilenji Jehovah Esekiel: ‘Keer tuguk che yaach che yae bik eng’ hekalut. Keer inatusiek, kinyi pichainikab ndarok ak tiong’ik alak ago kutung’jin Israelik!’ Kigeerei Esekiel tuguchuto ak kosirei tuguk che yaaksei.

Kiteebe Jehovah Esekiel kolenji: ‘Igeere tuguk che yae kandoikab Israel eng’ ung’ot?’ Ee, keerei Esekiel murenik 70 kosae cheptalelisiek ak komwae kole: ‘Ma keerech Jehovah amu kigometo emet.’

Ki ye ibata noto, koboorji Jehovah Esekiel kwonyik che ki mi murot katam ne bo kurgetab hekalut che kisae cheptalelit ne kiguure Tamus. Kigeer kora Esekiel murenik che ki negit 25 ko mi kurgetab hekalut. Ki kutung’dos kogeere kong’asis murenichoto ak kosae asista!

Kole Jehovah: ‘Mateegison bichu. Yae yaitiet ak kobwanei agoi hekalunnyun si koyai tuguk che yaach.’ Komwa Jehovah kole: ‘Nae icheget neregekyuk, ago ma riree icheget ye king’em.’ Kingobata kenyisiek somogu kityo kong’eete ngomwachi Jehovah Esekiel ng’alechu, kongelelji Israelik Nebukadnesar. Ki wo anyun Nebukadnesar kobargei ak Israelik. Kingobata kenyit agenge ak nusu, koba bikab Babulon ak koluul inatusiekab Jerusalem ak kobel nganasanoto kobeg. Kibeg bik che chang’ ak kimut alak koek mabusiek eng’ Babulon.

Amu nee si koyan Jehovah keng’em Israelik? Kiiyan amu ma kas it icheget Jehovah ago ma isub ng’atutikyik. Ibooru nito kole bo kamanut keyai kit ne mwawech Kamuktaindet betusiek tugul.

Ki eng’ tai, ko kigiyanji bik tutigin kong’et eng’ emetab Israel. Konde Nebukadnesar Yahudiot ne kiguure Gedalia kotelelji bichoto. Nga u noto, kobar Israelik alage Gedalia. Ki arogenso bik amu kiiywei kole imuch kobwa bikab Babulon kobar bichoto tugul kosubgei ak baretab Gedalia. Ki nam anyun Israelik Jeremia eng’ kimnatet ak koba komwechi emetab Misri.

Ki ye ba Israelik, ko ma mi chi ne ki meny emonoto eng’ kenyisiek 70. Ki ng’et emet buch. Nga u noto, ko kimwa Jehovah kole ye ibata kenyisiek 70 koweegu bikyik kobwa emennywa. Ara anyun nee ne kiyaaksei eng’ bikab Jehovah che ki mi emetab Babulon kasarata? Ngegeer.2 Laitorinik 25:1-26; Jeremia 29:10; Esekiel 1:1-3; 8:1-18. Teebutik che Kineetengei
